scope: Contracts 2-4 of 29 only; box topology, bounds and different-slot separation for two arbitrary points

exact_headers.name: NLA.SP15.parameter_box_geometry
exact_headers.header: theorem parameter_box_geometry : IsOpen parameterBox ∧ basePoint ∈ parameterBox

exact_headers.name: NLA.SP15.parameter_box_bounds
exact_headers.header:
theorem parameter_box_bounds (x : Parameters) (hx : x ∈ parameterBox) :
    (∀ i : Fin 3, 0 < pCoordinates x i) ∧ 0 < x 6 ∧ 0 < x 7 ∧
    ∀ i : Fin 3,
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, ‖qMatrix x i j‖) + 3 / 4 < (qMatrix x i i).re

exact_headers.name: NLA.SP15.p_intervals_separate
exact_headers.header:
theorem p_intervals_separate (x y : Parameters) (hx : x ∈ parameterBox)
    (hy : y ∈ parameterBox) (i j : Fin 3) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    pCoordinates x i ≠ pCoordinates y j

LeanCert_consumption: box_scalar_certificate supplies positive radius, positive 1-r, gap 1-2r, exact 3/4 row margin; no interval computation repeated
